sumInsured: As per Policy Schedule (not provided in extract)

great.name: Room Rent
great.quote: Eligibility of Room Category of the insured person is 'no sub-limit', which means that there is no separate restriction on Room/Boarding and nursing expenses in case of Hospitalization.
great.explanation: Room/boarding and nursing expenses have 'no sub-limit' during hospitalization. You can choose any room category without a room-rent cap reducing your claim.

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: automatically make the re-instatement of up to the base Sum Insured once in a policy year... Recharge amount can be utilized for same illness as well as different Illnesses.
great.explanation: Automatically reinstates up to the base Sum Insured once in a policy year. The recharge can be used for the same illness or a different illness, giving extra cover after the base SI is used.

good.name: Modern Treatments
good.quote: The Company will indemnify... for treatment taken through following advance technology methods: ... Robotic surgeries ... Immunotherapy- Monoclonal Antibody ... Stem cell therapy: Hematopoietic stem cells...
good.explanation: Covers listed advanced technology treatments like robotic surgeries, immunotherapy (monoclonal antibody) and hematopoietic stem cell therapy. This reduces the risk of denial for newer treatment methods, though any limits would depend on the policy terms/schedule.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED)... shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are not covered for the first 36 months of continuous coverage. Claims for declared/known conditions will be payable only after this waiting period ends.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage
good.explanation: Listed conditions/surgeries are not covered for the first 24 months of continuous coverage. Even if not pre-existing, these treatments become payable only after 2 years.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: Illness-related claims are not covered in the first 30 days from the first policy start date, except accidents. This is the standard initial waiting period in retail health insurance.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: Under Pre-hospitalization Medical Expenses, for a period of 30 days immediately prior to the Insured Person's date of admission
good.explanation: Covers pre-hospitalization medical expenses for 30 days before admission. This helps pay for tests/consultations leading up to hospitalization.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: Under Post-hospitalization Medical Expenses, for a period of 60 days immediately after the Insured Person's date of discharge
good.explanation: Covers post-hospitalization medical expenses for 60 days after discharge. This supports follow-up treatment and medicines during recovery.

good.name: Built-in SI Buffer
good.quote: the Company shall automatically provide an additional Sum Insured equal to the Sum Insured... (i) ...utilized only after the Sum Insured has been completely exhausted;
good.reference: Clause 3.2.10 – Optional Cover 10 Additional Sum Insured for Accidental Hospitalization
good.explanation: If this optional cover is chosen, an additional Sum Insured equal to the Sum Insured is provided for accidental hospitalization. It can be used only after the base Sum Insured is completely exhausted.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: Any item or condition or treatment specified in List of Non-Medical Items (Annexure – II to Policy Terms & Conditions).
bad.reference: Clause 4.2(a)(1) + Annexure II (List of Expenses Generally Excluded)
bad.explanation: Non-medical/consumable items listed in Annexure II are excluded from claims. You may have to pay common hospital add-ons (often billed as consumables) from your own pocket.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: The Co-payment proportion (if applicable) as specified in the Policy Schedule shall be borne by the Policyholder / Insured Person on each Claim
bad.reference: General Conditions Applicable to all the Benefits – Point 3
bad.explanation: A co-payment may apply as per the Policy Schedule and would be payable by you on each claim. Any applied co-pay increases out-of-pocket cost even on otherwise admissible claims.

unclear.name: No Claims Bonus
unclear.quote: In the event of a Claim occurring during any Policy Year, the accrued No Claims Bonus will be reduced at same rate at which it is accrued at the commencement of next Policy Year;
unclear.explanation: On a claim, the accrued No Claims Bonus is reduced at the same rate at which it was accrued. The exact impact depends on the accrual/reduction rate specified elsewhere (e.g., schedule), so the net benefit varies.

unclear.name: Disease Sub-limits
unclear.quote: If any sub-limits on Room Rent/Category for Medical Expenses are applicable as specified in the Policy Schedule... For diseases or conditions or procedure that have a specified sub-limit then all related expenses shall be covered up to the sub-limit specified
unclear.explanation: Disease/procedure sub-limits may apply if specified in the Policy Schedule. If present, claims for those treatments would be capped to the listed sub-limit, so you must check your schedule.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
